{"number": 1514, "label": "bug", "route": "repro-check", "related": [2481, 1318, 1636], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/progress/MockingProgressImpl.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/stubbing/StubberImpl.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/stubbing/answers/ThrowsExceptionForClassType.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/stubbing/InvocationContainerImpl.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/MockitoCore.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/handler/MockHandlerImpl.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the detailed report. The snippet and the Mockito version (2.23.0) are helpful, but we need two things before we can confirm the bug:

1) The full stack trace of the InstantiationError, showing where it is thrown. The report only quotes the Mockito message and the caught error.
2) Whether the snippet still fails on the latest Mockito release. Exception creation has changed since 2.23.0: in the current source, doThrow(Class) builds the exception lazily in ThrowsExceptionForClassType.getThrowable(), and stubbing is marked complete in InvocationContainerImpl.addAnswer().

The stack trace will tell us whether the stale unfinished-stubbing state still occurs."}
